response.justification: The candidate is a versatile senior engineer with genuine geospatial experience (GISCollective, Green Map) and low-latency systems work in DLang, but modern C++ experience is limited to a brief stint over a decade ago, there is no Rust, and recent roles have centered on TypeScript/Node full-stack product work rather than routing pipelines or navigation systems. The systems and geospatial background suggests transferable skills, but the core language requirement and lack of navigation-guidance experience are significant gaps for a role where C++ is primary.
strengths: Hands-on geospatial/GIS platform experience as founder of GISCollective and Green Map contributor
Low-latency, high-throughput systems experience (async I/O, fibers, caching) at Dunnhumby/Sociomantic
Broad polyglot background with strong testing/quality culture (TDD, CI/CD, test tooling author)
concerns: Minimal modern C++ experience — last professional C++ role ended in 2015, no Rust
No direct experience with routing engines, routing tiles, or navigation guidance systems
Recent years focused on TypeScript/Node product work, distant from data-pipeline/distributed-systems engineering
